items.item_text: Current BLS certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross
Bachelor’s degree in Behavioral sciences or related field and 3 years experience in a psychiatric inpatient setting OR
Master’s degree and 2 years of experience in a psychiatric inpatient setting or equivalent

Join our Neuropsychiatric Hospital and become part of a multidisciplinary team committed to supporting individuals experience acute mental health needs focusing on OCD. In this role, you will provide direct patient care under the supervision of a Registered Nurse and interdisciplinary team, helping implement and evaluate established treatment plans while supporting a safe and therapeutic environment. You will collaborate closely with nurses and other healthcare professions to monitory patient progress, support daily care needs, facilitate therapeutic activities, and contribute to individualized patient care planning. Key responsibilities:
Provide direct patient care in accordance with established nursing care plans and medical orders
Monitor and report changes in patient behavior, appearance, symptoms, and overall condition
Support therapeutic programming through individual, small group, and large group activities
Assist with activities of daily living and therapeutic milieu management
Document patient observations, interventions, and clinical outcomes accurately and timely
Collaborate with nurses and interdisciplinary team members to support patient treatment goals
Assist in maintaining a safe environment and respond appropriately to behavioral health emergencies
Please note: this is a part-time position
Understanding of multidisciplinary healthcare team collaboration
Knowledge of group dynamics and therapeutic group processes
Knowledge of psychological functioning and behavioral change
Knowledge of therapeutic communication techniques
Ability to assess, observe, and report patient behavior and concerns
Knowledge of managing assaultive behavior and utilizing appropriate safety interventions
Ability to develop, implement, and evaluate patient-focused activities and therapeutic programming
Strong verbal and written communication skills
